cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fence finished. I'll give you the proper account: my whole Saturday went into those three panels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They look good. I'll tell next door; they need six done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I planned two shop trips and drove eighteen screws. It wasn't a spare half-hour. Use your own words, obviously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll just say you worked hard. I'm not reciting a tool list over the fence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A concise account, good. Say I worked hard all Saturday. That's the bit I need them to hear before they ask about Sunday.

reason: Make the repairer manage a proposed recommendation while yielding the form B will actually use, preserving specific time credit as the pursuit.
